description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related functions for managing media key system support, including querying supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and retrieving version information. It also includes factory creation methods and a utility function to convert error statuses to strings.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements support querying for supported media key systems, their versions, and support status.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeysCapabilities instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating MediaKeysCapabilities instances.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaKeyErrorStatus enum values to their string representations.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaKeysCapabilities object with provided OCdmFactory and OCdmSystemFactory.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system strings.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
